5584.title: [4.152] Use Windows SDK resource compiler for ANGLE
5584.body:
Backport the resource-compiler fix from mono/SkiaSharp#5537 (f515dd58d9782a208a569532512db736838c7a22) to release/4.152.x. Remove the Chromium rc.exe GCS download and patch branch-pinned rc.py to use Windows SDK rc.exe, preserving preprocessing and dependency tracking with explicit shape validation and idempotent writes. Use servicing's existing System.IO APIs; retain all other bootstrap logic and dependency pins.

Validation: dotnet cake native/winui-angle/build.cake --dryrun passed. Transformation validated against Chromium build a18493935f13d1b0992c78f5615a5d10336d60c0 (ANGLE chromium/6275), including Python syntax, unchanged helper ASTs, repeated application and rejected unexpected shapes. Windows native x86/x64/arm64 end-to-end validation remains pending CI; unavailable on macOS. Historical public AzDO build 1657048 validates the original fix, not this backport.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
